data.one_liner: Official Split plugin for feature flags and controlled rollouts in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interface to the Split platform for feature flagging. Allows evaluating treatments to control app behavior and user experience across Android, iOS, and Web.
use_when: You need feature flagging or controlled rollouts via Split.io in your Flutter app.
You want to evaluate treatments on Android, iOS, or Web.
avoid_when: You use a different feature flag management platform.
You do not require remote feature flag configuration.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Split.io service and ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires an SDK key and user key from Split.io. Minimum iOS version is 12, Android SDK 21+.
